+from typing import List, Optional, Sequence, Union
+from fastapi._compat.shared import field_annotation_is_sequence, field_annotation_is_scalar_sequence, field_annotation_is_scalar
+
+# Python 3.10+ union syntax
+try:
+    from types import UnionType
+except ImportError:
+    UnionType = type(int | None) if hasattr(int, "__or__") else None
+
+def test_type(annotation, expected_seq, expected_scalar_seq):
+    seq = field_annotation_is_sequence(annotation)
+    scalar_seq = field_annotation_is_scalar_sequence(annotation)
+    print(f"Type: {annotation}, Seq: {seq} (exp: {expected_seq}), ScalarSeq: {scalar_seq} (exp: {expected_scalar_seq})")
+    assert seq == expected_seq, f"Seq failed for {annotation}: {seq} != {expected_seq}"
+    assert scalar_seq == expected_scalar_seq, f"ScalarSeq failed for {annotation}: {scalar_seq} != {expected_scalar_seq}"
+
+# Test cases
+# Standard sequences
+test_type(list[int], True, True)
+test_type(List[int], True, True)
+test_type(Sequence[int], True, True)
+
+# Optional sequences (Python 3.10 syntax)
+test_type(list[int] | None, True, True)
+test_type(Sequence[int] | None, True, True)
+
+# Optional sequences (typing.Optional)
+test_type(Optional[list[int]], True, True)
+test_type(Optional[Sequence[int]], True, True)
+
+# Union of sequences
+test_type(list[int] | list[str], True, True)
+
+# Union of sequence and non-sequence
+test_type(list[int] | int, True, False)
+
+# Union of sequence and complex type
+test_type(list[int] | dict[str, int], True, False)
+
+print("All tests passed!")
